q: Thermal Power Plant mein mukhya fuel ke roop mein kya use hota hai?
explanation: Thermal Power Plant mein koyla (Coal) jalakar steam banayi jati hai.

q: Hydroelectric Power Plant mein kaun-si energy electrical energy mein badalti hai?
explanation: Dam mein jama paani ki Potential Energy turbine ko ghumakar bijli banati hai.

q: Nuclear Power Plant mein Moderator ka kaam kya hota hai?
explanation: Moderator (Graphite ya Heavy Water) fast neutrons ki speed slow karta hai.
